`apple-guide-attestation.cbor` is the sample attestation object from Apple's
"Attestation Object Validation Guide"
(https://developer.apple.com/documentation/devicecheck/attestation-object-validation-guide),
base64-decoded. App ID `1234567890.com.example.myapp`; the app passed the
bytes of `example_server_challenge` as `clientDataHash`; key identifier
`zgSY9YSD+7TaDXssY6WlOPVS1K3Lmk+pFhlcSWE+ZV0=`; credential certificate valid
2026-04-20 to 2026-04-23.
